operations.name: evaluate_frame
operations.signature: fn evaluate_frame<'a>(view: SceneView<'a>, time_seconds: f64, byte_budget: usize, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<EvaluatedFrame<'a>>; fn update_animation_clips(frame: &mut EvaluatedFrame<'_>, shape: ShapeId, update_bounds: bool, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.implementation: Normal production evaluation requires a finite caller frame budget and passes it unchanged to FrameBuilder. Finished-frame actual old/new overlap retains that policy. No frame-wide default exists; the distinct original clip clone cap remains 64 MiB. Existing overlay, geometry, color, inverse, instance and clip algorithms remain implemented. R2 tests admit overlap above 64 MiB under explicit 128 MiB policy, reject a single clip above its original cap, and prove cancellation through empty shape suffixes and actual edge loops. Raster dispatch awaits actual later runtime adapters.
operations.contract: Explicit caller policy; original separate clip cap; all-record checked IDs; effective owner refs; active overlay order; supported/unsupported behavior; owner-before-suffix matrices; actual nested capacities; every variable owned loop polls control; original local work totals/caps retained separately from job polling; atomic publication.

loop_audit.lib.rs:copy_table: Each table item charges job control; allocations are fallible.
loop_audit.lib.rs:product: Forward ancestry charges original local work and job control; reverse matrix composition charges job control only.
loop_audit.lib.rs:shape_bounds,map_shape_edges: Original aggregate edge-count local admission retained; job control charges inside each edge iteration. Each edge processes a fixed two endpoints.
loop_audit.lib.rs:evaluate_frame: Active/clip detection, boolean initialization, world initialization, all overlay items including inactive items, transform/shape/ancestry scans, clip flags and publication comparison loops all poll/charge each iteration. World initialization retains original source transform and adds no legacy local work.
loop_audit.lib.rs:has_effect: Each group charges original local work and job control.
loop_audit.apply.rs:apply_value: Each shape/target ancestry/direct-node visit and color/alpha edge iteration polls; original target early exits, direct-node charge and aggregate color local counts retained.
loop_audit.clips.rs:node_product,shape_has_node: Forward ancestry retains original local increments; reverse product polls without extra local increments.
loop_audit.clips.rs:bounds_for_node: Each shape uses ReferenceProbe even with no node/edges; contributing edges charge original local work and poll individually. Fixed endpoint pairs run within edge polling.
loop_audit.clips.rs:update_clip_owner: Original 64 local units per shape retained; actual outer shape and each clip ancestor poll separately.
loop_audit.clips.rs:update_clip_shape: Each outer ancestry iteration polls; nested product/bounds/owner loops poll as listed.
loop_audit.clips.rs:clone_clip_table,actual_clip_ca: Estimation, top-level clone, nested edge/child copying and actual capacity scans each poll in-loop. Allocation overhead does not consume legacy transform-local work.
